svg.title: Workflow: Cloud managed-services support transformation
svg.desc: Solution workflow (hybrid) for Cloud managed-services support transformation: 1 trigger: Observability platform raises an alert, or a ticket arrives by email, portal or team chat → event; 2 system: Auto incident tracking: alerts are correlated, de-duplicated and opened as a tracked incident linked to affected tickets → incident; 3 workflow: Fires once on creation and calls the main agent → one AI action; 4 agent: AI triage: scans for P1/P2 emergency signals, classifies type, category, priority → structured output; 5 decision: P1/P2 or change request? yes → step 6 / no → step 7; 6 guardrail: No AI reply; route to on-call queue or approval board → human-only handling; 7 skill: Searches KB and runbooks; for alerts, graph lookup and on-demand cloud log and metric pulls → grounded context; 8 agent: Drafts the reply or customer notification and SOP checklist, or NO_RESPONSE → draft; 9 human: Reviews, personalises and approves send (100% on customer-impacting actions; supervised mode early on) → sent communication; 10 workflow: Awaiting-requester stage then auto-resolve and close after N days of silence; incident resolution closes linked tickets → closed records; 11 outcome: Alert-to-customer notice and human touch-time under 5 minutes (target) → more customers per team
